Die Fläche biegt sich um eine Achse para: The area bends around an axis parallel to the slits. Smaller row spacing and longer slits = softer. For 3 mm plywood, 1.5 mm spacing and 20 mm slits are a good start. The area itself is not changed.
Für jedes Innenteil (z. B. im O, A, B, 8: For each inner part (e.g. in O, A, B, 8) a bridge is laid through the shape so that it stays attached when the stencil is cut out.
Teilkreis = Modul × Zähne. Räder mit gle: Pitch circle = module × teeth. Gears with the same module mesh; the center distance is module × (teeth 1 + teeth 2) / 2. From about 17 teeth on there is no undercut.
